identity.original_title: Touhou Rinrinki ~ Crafts of the Lucky Beast

hooks.text: 灵梦调查席卷幻想乡的卡牌决斗异变，并与其他决斗者共同追查幕后秘密
hooks.excerpt: Gensokyo faces a new Incident: a sudden craze for card duels! What secret lies behind? As the shrine maiden and expert in Incident resolving, Reimu sets out to investigate… But she won’t be the only one!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 从横跨四季的200多张独特卡牌中构筑最终牌组
hooks.excerpt: Build your ultimate deck from over 200 unique cards across four seasons!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 挑战30多名独特对手、收集100多件物品，并强化决斗者专属技能追击幕后主使
hooks.excerpt: Battle 30+ unique opponents, collect 100+ powerful items, and upgrade your Duelist's unique skill to confront the mastermind behind the chaos!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: 音乐方面再丰富一点就好了。

opinions.text: 正式版流程更长，已经能形成构筑爽感。

opinions.text: 锦标赛随机事件与自选卡组结合，玩起来舒适。

opinions.text: 战棋、卡牌和肉鸽组合精准命中玩家喜好。

excerpts.excerpt: 东方+战棋+卡牌+Roguelike，能不能不要这么每一针都扎中要害
